name: oppassum
description: No-login peer-to-peer browser file sharing using Socket.io signaling and WebRTC DataChannel.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @oppassum/shared && npm run build --workspace @oppassum/signaling && npm run build --workspace @oppassum/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @oppassum/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @oppassum/signaling && npm run typecheck --workspace @oppassum/web
